text: Montok Redhands was an orc Warsong Gulch battlemaster located in the Lower City in Shattrath City during the Call to Arms: Warsong Gulch.

Moonheart is a remote night elf village. When no word came from the village, an exploratory party was sent to find out what had happened. They discovered that the inhabitants were still alive...but twisted into corrupt and blood thirsty satyrs. Moonheart's location is unknown, though it is somewhere in Kalimdor.

Morbent Fel was a human necromancer who ruled over the undead of Duskwood from his homely house atop the Forlorn Rowe in Raven Hill Cemetery. He was guarded by his undead minions as well as a magical barrier that dampened attacks on his person. He was an ally of the Dark Riders, and was the one responsible for raising the undead in Duskwood. In order to defeat him, one had to first remove his magical shield using Morbent's Bane. He was very hard to hit with the shield active (unless one was of a significantly higher level than him) and the quest objective to kill him would not be completed. After the Cataclysm, Morbent Fel returned as a lich (likely in homage to the similarly-named random he

Morg Wolfsong was an orc shaman. His caravan was ambushed by a band of renegade orc warlocks still loyal to the Burning Legion. The warlocks killed the shaman, stole one of their sacred artifacts - a powerful relic - and then fled back into the hills, to their secret coven nearby. Rexxar found mortally wounded Morg among the dead bodies of his fellow shaman. Morg asked Rexxar to avenge the ghosts of his murdered brethren and recover the stolen artifact. Rexxar found the secret coven, as that place "reeked of evil" and destroyed the warlocks. He returned the sacred relic to Morg and it calmed the ghosts of the fallen shaman. Morg asked Rexxar to take the artifact and the rest of their items.
Moonshroud Residue is a buff that is given to tailors when they create a Moonshroud.

Myzerian is a black dragon found circling around Obelisk of the Moon in the Uldum. He is Deathwing's emissary overseeing Commander Schnottz's expedition within Uldum. At first, he takes a human guise, however adventurers' actions on behalf of Harrison Jones cause him to reveal his real form. During Shroud of the Makers (quest), Myzerian is caught up in the explosion that kills most of the elite Schnottz troopers guarding the obelisk. While still flying, he obviously took some damage as he is both on fire and repeatedly dropping out of the sky. It is only in this weakened state that he can be killed, as it is impossible to kill him both in his visage and when he is at full health thanks to a

Naros is an orc armor vendor located at the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. He controls Naros' Armory found in the valley. He can be seen in the Siege of Orgrimmar. After the battle of the Broken Shore, he could be found alongside other concerned citizens of the Horde in front of Grommash Hold. After Vol'jin's death, he was speaking with Punra and Sana. He appears in the Vision of Orgrimmar. After killing him, the player receives the Smith's Strength buff.

Narsysix is a black dragon accompanying Sabellian in the Obsidian Citadel in the Waking Shores. She stands next to her sister, Exadria, remaining at Sabellian's side when he descends from the Obsidian Throne. She can also be found at Dragonbane Keep after it has been reclaimed; thanking the player on behalf of Sabellian and the flight for aiding the Obsidian Outcasts with reclaiming their home. She stands next to a Blacktalon Schemer and their Blacktalon Pack Goat. She can also be seen flying around Loamm in Zaralek Cavern.
Nayeth Frostmoon is a night elf that would be located in Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City prior to the discovery of Pandaria.

Neheri is a Bishop within the Church of the Holy Light and is a leader of one of three power bases within the council. The youngest of the bishops, tall, powerfully built Neheri is part of the new order of the Church. He fought in the Third War, shoulder to shoulder with the night elves and the orcs, and actively attempts to recruit non-humans. Neheri also feels the time of passive protection is long past - the Church needs to attack its enemies rather than waiting for them to strike. He is less concerned with his own behavior, feeling that priests should have some leeway in order to better protect their people. He has won most of the younger priests to his cause, and battles Hylan bitterly

Nemsy Necrofizzle is a gnome warlock who is the second warlock hero in Hearthstone. Don’t let Nemsy Necrofizzle’s small size and penchant for peaches fool you: behind those pigtails and goggles hides one of the most powerful Warlocks alive. Nemsy is utterly fearless, sharp as a razor, and she’s always cool under pressure. After all, you can’t command fel energies or summon horrifying demons from the twisting nether just by being nice. She’s your perky little pal—and a bonafide fel-flinging, soul-destroying mistress of dark forces! Nemsy loves it when her foes underestimate her. Appearances can be deceiving, and she knows that it’s what lies beneath the surface that counts.

Chieftain Ohseso is a jungle troll and the leader of the Shatterspear tribe in Shatterspear Vale in Darkshore after the Fourth War. He continues to rebuild, in hopes that the tribe can ever answer the Horde's call.
Owen Vaughn is a human reagent vendor located in the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City. He briefly moves to the Stormwind Harbor during the Battle for the Broken Shore.

Pathstalker Ralsir is a high elf rogue trainer located in the Silver Enclave in the mage city of Dalaran. He was present in the city when it relocated above Deadwind Pass but did not offer his training services as he had to remain alert for any danger to Dalaran's visitors.
Private Jacint is a human located in the Hall of Blades in the Shattered Halls. He is held captive by the Shattered Hand Executioner.
Private Jackson is a human provisioner located near the flight master in Moonbrook in Westfall. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Quelis is a blood elf cooking vendor located on the upper floor of Wayfarer's Rest between the Walk of Elders and the Bazaar in Silvermoon City.

Rajis Fyashe is a naga and leader of the Bloodscale tribe found in Bloodscale Grounds in Zangarmarsh. She summons Bloodscale Elementals. She was a powerful sorceress, but her magical skills proved ineffective against agents of the Cenarion Expedition.

Rajin was the leader of a group of young Zandalari scamps in Zuldazar during Zenbaro's youth. He gave his fellow scamps shelter, and in return, they did whatever he asked, which usually meant running scams in the city or stealing from the coffers in the loa temple. Early on, Rajin took notice of the skills of Zenbaro, who was shortly running personal errands for Rajin. If someone needed "talking to", Zenbaro was the one to do it, but there was not much actual talking involved. Before long, Zenbaro earned Rajin's trust and respect, as much as anyone could, but Zenbaro was more interested in Rajin's beautiful daughter Kaiani. Kaiani asked Zenbaro to leave the city with her, and from that day o
Ranger Selron is a blood elf found in Eversong Woods patrolling a small section of the road nearby Silvermoon City.

Ranid Glowergold is a dwarf Leatherworking and Skinning supplies vendor at Legendary Leathers in Dalaran. He is one of Namha Moonwater's apprentices. Ranid apparently considers himself to have refined tastes in food, although the cooks of Dalaran know better. When he requests a wine and cheese platter, they send the player to get limburger cheese, known for its pungent odor, and leftover wine from half-empty glasses poured into a wine bottle and served on an old shield. As they suspect, Ranid is oblivious and more than happy with the 'vintage' he was sent. Legion introduced his twin, Thanid Glowergold. When Dalaran relocated above Deadwind Pass and the Burning Legion attacked the city, he fo

Father Rammal was a blood elf who, in the guise of a human, was sought out by the annihilan Verius who wore a human disguise. Verius hoped he could manipulate Rammal in recommending the demon's inclusion to the Silver Hand. Having seen through Verius' disguise with the aid of a magical amulet, a female elf within the chapel revealed that both she and "Rammal" were in fact blood elves, a race highly sensitive and addicted to magic. Verius roared as the blood elves fell upon him.

Ranger Selone is a high elf hunter trainer located in the Silver Enclave in the mage city of Dalaran. She is one of the elven rangers of Quel'Thalas. She was present in the city when it relocated above Deadwind Pass but did not offer his training services as she had to remain alert for any danger to Dalaran's visitors.
Rauvir is a void elf located at the Stormwind Embassy in Stormwind City. He can also be found discussing mysteriously with Dewil and two Riftwarden Acolytes in a small alley behind the City Hall.
Razia is a blood elf located in the Court of the Sun in Silvermoon City.

Ren Firetonuge is a pandaren fire mage of the Golden Lotus. During the Golden Lotus daily quests, he is assigned with He Softfoot to guard Whitepetal Lake. Unlike most pandaren, Ren is highly narcissistic about both his abilities and looks, at one point asking if the player has come to "bask in my marvelous company." Ren has a sarcastic and condescending way of speaking to the player. Apparently, Ren was not at the Golden Pagoda when it was destroyed and can now only be found at the secluded Ruins Rise hanging his head down and asking adventurers to leave him be. Ren as a projection of negative emotions is seen inside Siege of Orgrimmar as the Embodied Sorrow summoned by his fallen comrade,

Ren Quickhand is a human thief found in the catacombs underneath the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City. He killed a Hired Courier for the crate in which he intended to sell through the local auction house, but was refused by Auctioneer Fitch, then referred to the Shady Lady. They arranged a meeting with an interested buyer, Archmage Xylem, to take place above Undercity. The meeting would be with his servant Sanath Lim-yo. Sanath refused to bargain with Ren and chose to kill him instead, but just before leaving heroes arrive to disrupt him.
Researcher Tiorus is a blood elf found in Shadowmoon Village in Shadowmoon Valley where he intends to study the corrupted wildlife.
Rifleman Brownbeard is a dwarf located in the Hall of Blades in the Shattered Halls. He is held captive by the Shattered Hand Executioner.
Richard Trueflight is a human flight master located at Eastwall Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands.

Ritssyn Flamescowl is a powerful orc warlock member of the Council of the Black Harvest. After participating in the fall of Ragnaros, he convened with his fellow warlocks of the Council. He was partnered with Zinnin Smythe to go back to Sulfuron Keep and gather the power left behind by the Firelord.
Rotwing Pestilent is a large undead dragon flying around over the Shattered Span in Bastion.
Runetog Wildhammer is a Wildhammer dwarf gryphon flight master located at Shatter Point in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Ruuzel's Isle is a small island with a few night elf ruins. Ruuzel commands her Wrathtail naga forces from a hill on the center of the island.
Saah Maxwell is a human located at Stormwind City Cemetery in Stormwind City.

Salena is a blood elf flight master located at Sunveil Excursion in the Blasted Lands. She is found next to a Silvermoon Dragonhawk. Since the Ironmarch entered Azeroth through the Dark Portal, her whereabouts are unknown.

Sanath Tidebringer is a haughty human archmage who created a settlement for Kul Tiras on the Darkspear Islands during the Third War and was also on the lookout for the ships stolen by the Horde. He and his forces frequently hunted the Darkspear trolls on the island. The trolls later enlisted the Horde led by Thrall to defend them against these attacks and Thrall engaged their army in battle, with one of Tidebringer's footmen identifying Thrall as the thief of their ships. Though Tidebringer had the utmost confidence he would beat what he viewed as mere "ignorant brutes", Thrall and his forces proved to have the advantage and beat back the humans to their base. However as the Horde reached th

Sargeras (pronounced "SAHR-gair-ahs") is a titan and the creator and leader of the Burning Legion. He was once the champion of the Pantheon, chosen to defend the worlds the titans had ordered. However, while he once served as a guardian and protector, he later set out to destroy all world-souls and life in the universe, and undo what the titans had strived for ages to achieve. His actions and their effects essentially made him one of the main antagonists — or as Chris Metzen called him, "the big, mega bad guy" — of the Warcraft franchise, and he served as the main antagonist of Legion.

Sarannha Skyglaive is a commander of the night elf forces in Pandaria. Her sentinels play a vital role in the Alliance's acquisition of the :Divine Bell. Her team could first be seen at Mogujia, guarding the Explorer's League as they excavate the Horde-occupied mogu ruins. She ordered the deaths of blood elves at the ruins. She then moved to the Shrine of Seven Stars where the Alliance leaders spoke about the pros and cons of the sha power. After the Divine Bell was discovered within the Ruins of Korune, Skyglaive personally entered the ruins and defeated the mogu guardians within. When the Horde arrived not long after to take the bell, Skyglaive's team held the ruins until the bell was safe

Sarok is an orc located in The Broken Tusk in the Valley of Strength of Orgrimmar. During the Siege of Orgrimmar, he and some other inhabitants of the city are held captive by the Kor'kron. He had to follow Mojka into battle but apparently survived as he is still in Orgrimmar.

Sarias Colton was a human soldier of Stormwind who had been killed and raised by the Scourge during the Third War. He later regained his sanity and joined the Forsaken. Sylvanas Windrunner asked him and three others to travel to Stormwind City as emissaries and ask King Varian Wrynn to join the Alliance; Sarias and the others were chosen for the task as they had been admirable in life and were sufficiently intact to almost pass for living. Sarias felt honored by the assignment, and hoped also to see his sister once more. The emissaries never returned to the Undercity. Forsaken scouts later discovered Sarias's pouch outside Stormwind, still containing a letter, a locket with the face of a you
Sathren Azuredawn is a blood elf general goods vendor located in General Goods in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City.

Sathera was a high elven mage who was a close friend of Antonidas and Kael'thas. She teleported into the Violet Citadel's Arcane Vault when the alarm was sounded. It had been infiltrated by Teron Gorefiend and his death knights, who had been sent by Ner'zhul to retrieve the Eye of Dalaran. Antonidas had been afflicted by some dark spell cast by one of the death knights, but Sathera lifted the spell, saving her old friend. Soon afterwards, one of the death knights targeted her and blasted her with dark magic. She withered before Antonidas' eyes, and fell to the ground, dead. Shortly after, Teron Gorefiend and his death knights escaped with the Eye of Dalaran atop the backs of Deathwing and hi
Sergeant Kargrul is an orc found in Shadowmoon Village in Shadowmoon Valley.

Serinar is a black dragon located in the Maw of Neltharion in Dragonblight. A Burning Depths Necrolyte lies dead on the ground to his side. He has apparently played a part in destroying entire civilizations, and refers to the player as an "effective tool." Adventurers are sent to aid him in defending the Obsidian Dragonshrine. For a member of the black dragonflight he is rather friendly, expressing gratitude towards the player after they have succeeded in protecting the shrine. He is fighting against the Cult of the Damned.

Sergeant Cleese is the warrior trainer in Gilneas City and Gilneas. Following the conclusion of the Worgen starting experience, he can be found in the Howling Oak of Darnassus, where he continues to serve as a warrior trainer. During the Burning of Teldrassil, he was seemingly evacuated with the civilians to Stormwind City.

Shandrina was a night elf trade goods vendor located at Silverwind Refuge in Ashenvale. She was killed in the Horde attack on the refuge. As of Dragonflight, she can be seen floating around as a wisp in the city of Bel'Amath, Amirdrassil.

Shay Pressler is a human guild vendor located in the human capital of Stormwind City. He can be found in the Stormwind Visitor's Center, which is located beside the exit of the Valley of Heroes going into the Trade District. He is standing next to Adam Pressler, who is presumably his son. He was present among the concerned citizens when the Veiled Hand and the Uncrowned infiltrated the city.

Shauna Strattonmeier is a human sitting in the Royal Library in Stormwind City and reading from a book for a group of Attentive Children, Jordan Meier, and James Meier. To accompany Shauna's stories, James will occasionally summon magical fireworks or a projection of a rabbit to entertain the children.

Shinfel Blightsworn is a powerful blood elf warlock member of the Council of the Black Harvest. Present during the battle against Cho'gall, he made her become a slave within her very own mind. Her blood had been corrupted by his dark magics and her arms are now covered in black marks left behind by the corruption that had erupted from her skin. The experience had only served to increase the intensity of her sadism. Her attire of choice is adorned with sharp spikes of twilight elementium. After convening with her fellow warlocks on the Council, Shinfel was partnered with Zelifrax Wobblepox to hunt down the scattered remnants of the Twilight Cult, and glean what knowledge (and, consequently, p
Silvermoon City Commendation Officer was a blood elf located in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar.
Sir Nicholas Gabaree is a human ghost located at the Stormwind City Cemetery in Stormwind City. He appears when you click a grave that says 'In Loving Memory'
Siphon Power is a vengeance demon hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Shatter the Souls and Fiery Demise (artifact trait) tratis.
Sister Ali was a human in Stormwind City who handled teleports to areas being tested during the alpha and beta tests of World of Warcraft: Cataclysm.

Squire Rowe is a human located in the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind City. He seems to be in a relationship with, or have feelings for, Cersei Dusksinger according to his coin found in the Dalaran fountain. He can be found along the wall on the right when entering the city through the main gates.

Ssarbik is an arakkoa sorcerer of the Hidden and a companion of Malus and his team. He joined them on the search for Aramar Thorne and a compass across Feralas all in service of a master, the dreadlord Xaraax. Nearing near the land by a boat, Ssarbik used his shadow magic and sent the boat flying, landing on a safe land. He often questioned Malus, forcing the human to shut him up physically. Nonetheless, he continued to follow him. Once Malus killed King Gordok in Dire Maul and was acknowledged as the new leader of the Gordunni clan, Malus asked Ssarbik to contact his sister on the Inevitable and have the ship moved to Gadgetzan.

Starfeller is a famous half-elf in half-elven legend. He was the wisest half-elf ever, who hated the world so much that he built a great tower to take him to the stars. Unfortunately the stars rejected him and cast him back to earth, where his fall created a great crater.

Stonewatch Keep is the main structure of the human stronghold of Stonewatch, which also includes the Stonewatch Tower. Originally, Stonewatch used to be controlled by the humans of Lakeshire. One day however, the warlock Morganth made an alliance with the Blackrock orcs led by , and together they combined their forces to invade Redridge. Fueled by the evil magic of Morganth, the Blackrock orcs attacked Stonewatch Keep in Redridge with horrific savagery. Ultimately, they captured Stonewatch Keep, but shortly after their victory, Morganth turned on his orcish cohorts. He constructed an arcane tower, the Tower of Ilgalar, and used his powers to build a small army of Shadowhide gnolls led by , t
Sulamin is a blood elf located at the Sanctum of the Stars in Shadowmoon Valley.

Sunder Armor is one of the warrior's basic threat generation abilities. It is an instant attack that decreases your opponent's armor by 4% per stack. Sundering generates a high amount of threat, making it especially useful for tanking. Not only will it help you keep your opponent focused on you instead of your teammates, it will also increase the amount of damage you and your party members deal. For Protection warriors, Devastate replaces Sunder Armor at level 26.

Sunspring Post is a former Mag'har orc village with its own town hall on the shores of Lake Sunspring inhabited by the Murkblood tribe of Broken draenei, who destroyed the village and killed everyone they could find. Refugees made their way to the safety of the Mag'har city of Garadar, leaving their ruined village in the hands of the Murkblood tribe. However, there have been some reports from travellers that there may be some survivors trapped in the village.
Sylannia is a night elf drink vendor located in the Darkmoon Faire camp, which is only available during the monthly Darkmoon Faire event.
Talmar is a blood elf located in the Walk of Elders in Silvermoon City.
Targrom is an orc food and drink vendor located at Shadowmoon Village in Shadowmoon Valley.

Tari Cogg was a gnome mage of the Kirin Tor. She was known as one of the foremost gnome magi in Dalaran. Tari accompanied Rhonin to defend Theramore Isle, but was killed when the Horde destroyed the city with a mana bomb.
Tasha Tallen is a human located at Stormwind City Cemetery in Stormwind City.
Teon Cathun is a human located at Stormwind City Cemetery in Stormwind City.

Terric Brightwind is a blood elf located in the Bazaar of Silvermoon City. He is a part of the crowd listening to the arguments of Lyria Skystrider and Priest Ennas against the decision of the blood elven leaders to join with the Horde. He counters them with statements supporting these decisions.

First Arcanist Thalyssra is the leader of the nightborne of Suramar. Formerly a close advisor of Grand Magistrix Elisande, Thalyssra opposed the alliance with the Burning Legion during their third invasion of Azeroth. Betrayed by Advisor Melandrus during an attempted and exiled to the wilds, becoming a nightfallen, Thalyssra joined with the "outlanders" from the floating city of Dalaran and led the rebellion that toppled Elisande and freed Suramar from the Legion. Having established cordial relations with the blood elves of Silvermoon, Thalyssra eventually swore Suramar's allegiance to the Horde, seeking to reclaim her people's place in Azeroth. Thalyssra led the nightborne through the Fourt

Theresa Moulaine is a human robe vendor located in the Cathedral Square of Stormwind City. She is the co-proprietor of the shop Righteous Plates, alongside Agustus Moulaine, and Theresa is standing behind the counter, near the entrance. In the Vision of Stormwind, she is found dead within her shop, having seemingly been killed by Agustus Moulaine who is channeling void magic on her corpse.

Tichondrius is the leader of the nathrezim of the Burning Legion, under the command of Kil'jaeden and Archimonde. A powerful and cunning Dreadlord, Tichondrius served as an envoy of the Legion's will to Arthas Menethil as the Scourge prepared to summon the Legion to Azeroth. Tichondrius, along with the other Dreadlords, commanded the Scourge during the invasion of Kalimdor. Tichondrius later met his end in battle against the empowered Demon hunter Illidan Stormrage. He was a major character in the Warcraft III campaigns Path of the Damned, The Invasion of Kalimdor, and Eternity's End. While he appeared often, he was never available for the user to control. Tichondrius returns in World of War

Tidebearer was a name originally given to a troll warrior of the Gurubashi Empire by its Emperor. The warrior had found The Stone of the Tides and showed its magical powers to the Emperor. This later became a title for those who had been entrusted with the Stone.
Tina Skyden is a human flight master located at Moonbrook in Westfall. She was present during the Legion Invasions.
Torian is a blood elf warlock located in The Sanctum in Murder Row in Silvermoon City.

Torgus was a prestigious dragon rider of the Dragonmaw clan during and after the Second War. Markers and medallions from Doomhammer, Blackhand, and various other clan leaders such as Zuluhed dangled from the axe harness around his chest. He managed to get word of Gul'dan's betrayal back to his chieftain and the rest of the Horde after he saw his fellow rider, Bradok being killed by the warlock. Torgus brought the news to Doomhammer himself during the siege of Capital City. After the war, he was assigned to Grim Batol, under Nekros Skullcrusher, where the clan was keeping a large portion of the red dragonflight enslaved. During one particular mission, he and his draconic mount encountered the

Trade Prince Donais was a goblin trade prince found at Gallywix Pleasure Palace in Azshara. It has never been clear exactly what cartel he ran, but he appeared to be working with Jastor Gallywix and the Bilgewater Cartel in some capacity. Donais was the poster child of goblin enterprise. While his cartel adheres to strict neutrality policies in order to maximize profitability, this goblin wasn't above associating with anyone who could increase the volume of gold resting in his personal coffers. He was very rude and condescending to those below his status and sat on a pile of gold while wearing a tuxedo. Donais (and his gold pile) abruptly disappeared from the Pleasure Palace at some point. A

Trak'gen is an orc general goods vendor located in the Orgrimmar General Store in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. During the Siege of Orgrimmar, he and some other inhabitants of the city were held captive by the Kor'kron. He had to follow Mojka into battle but survived as he is still in Orgrimmar. After the battle at the Broken Shore, Trak'gen was found in the center of the Valley, speaking with denizens. After Vol'jin's death, he is seen speaking with Overlord Natoj telling him about the tremendous loss.
Trey Wells is a human located at Stormwind City Cemetery in Stormwind City.
Trop Rendlimb is an orc general goods vendor located at Shadowmoon Village in Shadowmoon Valley.

Tyrande is an ancient night elf princess and high priestess of the moon goddess, Elune. In ages past, she aided Furion and Illidan Stormrage in their battle to save Kalimdor from the Burning Legion. As well as being Elune's high priestess, she is the leader of the Sentinels a group of warrior women who have sworn to protect Kalimdor's shores while their male counterparts, the druids, sleep in the trance-like Emerald Dream. Tyrande is a fiery warrior and holds certain resentment for shouldering the defense of her land while the druids sleep. Her undying love for Furion Stormrage has given her strength and courage enough to face the centuries alone and uphold her sacred charge to defend Kalimd

Ula-Tek (or Ula'Tek) is a widely worshiped serpent goddess among the forest trolls in Zul'Aman. She may be an Old God or connected to the Old Gods. She is revered by the great witch doctor Ral'jin. He wanted to capture many prisoners for use in a massive sacrifice for a ritual to summon Ula-Tek the Serpent Goddess. The Ironforge dwarves were concerned having seen the devastation that an elemental lord's rebirth brings. They worried that a bonafide Old God must be even more powerful. The Dark Iron dwarves, however, were jubilant. They believed that Ula-Tek, perhaps an Old God, could serve as a companion and ally to Ragnaros. They sent a contingent to Zul'Aman to wish their goodwill in hopes t
Unstoppable was a Fury warrior artifact trait. It was linked to the Bloodcraze (artifact trait), Unrivaled Strength, and Thirst for Battle (artifact trait) traits.
Unrivaled Strength is a Fury warrior artifact trait. It is linked to the Battle Scars, Raging Berserker, and Unstoppable traits.

Urtharo is an orc weapon vendor located in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar, at the Shattered Axe stand. After the battle of the Broken Shore, he could be seen speaking with an Orgrimmar Grunt and Scout Manslayer near Grommash Hold. He is sometimes seen speaking with an Eager Tourist.

Urda Direflame is a Dark Iron dwarf located in Xibala in Zuldazar. She and her crew managed to find the Eye of Xibala. After she was killed, her body was caught in the teleportation spell and was brought into the Horde's camp in Xibala, along with her destroyed totems and the Eye.

Vaeron Kormar is a blood elf located in the Bazaar of Silvermoon City. He is a part of the crowd listening to the arguments of Lyria Skystrider and Priest Ennas against the decision of the blood elven leaders to join with the Horde. He counters them with statements supporting these decisions.

Valgar Highforge is a dwarf paladin and paladin trainer found on the second floor of the Hall of Mysteries in the Mystic Ward in Ironforge. He is the highest-ranking member of the Silver Hand present in the city. Following the Cataclysm, Valgar met new promising paladins of the Silver Hand in Ironforge and sent them to meet Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker, one of the foremost paladins in the realm, at the Cathedral of Light of Stormwind City after the latter was impressed with their rapid progress. Following the death of Tirion Fordring during the Battle for Broken Shore, Valgar Highforge moved to the Sanctum of Light to serve the new Highlord of the Silver Hand. There, he became the Grand Smith

Var'thal was a blood elf in the service of Prince Kael'thas Sunstrider. He wielded a warglaive. He found himself the victor in a confrontation against a felhound and eagerly proceeded to drain the demon of its magic, while thanking Illidan Stormrage for his gift to the blood elves. He contemplated how it would feel to feed on the energies of more powerful demons or even individuals like Jaina Proudmoore or the Lich King himself. Before leaving he said, "Your kind feeds us now, demon. You will make the blood elves strong so that we might repay those who abandoned us". He promised the creature to tell the Prince of their encounter.

Verius was a pit lord who, in the guise of a human, traveled to a chapel to manipulate a priest named Father Rammal into unwittingly assisting the demon in infiltrating the Silver Hand. Having seen through his disguise with the aid of a magical amulet, a female elf within the chapel revealed that both she and "Rammal" were in fact blood elves, a race highly sensitive and addicted to magic. Verius roared as the blood elves fell upon him.

Vesprystus is a night elf hippogryph flight master located in Rut'theran Village in Teldrassil. After the invasion of Outland, Vesprystus was visited by gladiator champions Lo'Gosh and Broll Bearmantle who asked him if Sharptalon is able to fly to Theramore. His response was positive. An hour later, he was visited by a mysterious man asking about the two gladiators. Moments later, two young night elves asked him about the famous pair. While speaking with the girls, Valeera Sanguinar spied on Vesprystus. From his conversation with the elves, she learned about Theramore and the mysterious man. It's unknown whether he survived the Burning of Teldrassil.
Veynna Dawnstar is a blood elf armor vendor located in the Seer's Library atop the Scryer's Tier in Shattrath City.

Waltion Freemore is a human rogue and the leader of the Four Finger rogues of the Stormwind Assassins. He is in his seventies but walks with a straight back and strong step. He is bald with clear, blue eyes and a pudgy build. Waltion was one of the first rogues Pathonia Shaw recruited from the Stockade. He served as her right-hand man and lover for 30 years, helping her build the Stormwind Assassins guild into the powerhouse it is today. He is the grandfather of Mathias Shaw, but no one knows of the relationship he had with the powerful Pathonia, and he has promised to keep that secret. He knows he is at the end of his life, but agreed to stay with the guild for five years to aid Mathias, an

Widge Whistlevalve is a gnome tinker and a member of the Alliance. Widge wields a club, a gnomish orczapper, and a gnomish mind remote. He knows how to craft and use technological devices as well as how to repair them. He also knows how to decipher script and has knowledge of dungeoneering. He was once hired by Molus Blackburn (who had been in disguise) to break into the lair of the necromancer Toren Snapjoint and destroy him. He was hired along with fellow Alliance members, including Botrek Pahno, Cerise Moonrain, Maith'hal, Jarlath Brewbelly, and Yinny. After battling Toren, his acolytes and his undead servants in the necromancer's cave, Molus entered the cave no longer disguised, and with

William Kielar is a human ghost :spectral gryphon flight master located at the Plaguewood Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands. If a faction captured the four original towers, Kielar would spawn for only that current faction and offer free, one-way short cuts to the tower of their choice. His son William Kielar Jr., a member of the Argent Crusade, now resides at the tower as the flight master. He has been missing since the Cataclysm, possibly having finally found peace in death as the Argent Crusade cleansed Plaguewood Tower.

Wildhammer Fact Checker is a young Wildhammer dwarf historian located in the High Seat in Ironforge, next to Falstad Wildhammer. He is much smaller than a typical dwarf, indicating that he is a boy or a teenager. He was present when Kurdran Wildhammer gave the final piece of Modimus' hammer for reforging. He can also be seen wandering on Darkmoon Island. He claims that Ironforge Rams were the first type of ram domesticated by the dwarves when they settled in Dun Morogh.
Wolf-Sister Maka was an elite orc Alterac Valley battlemaster located in the Lower City in Shattrath City during the Call to Arms: Alterac Valley.

Xolotal is an unknown creature that, presumably, manifests itself in the form of a wolf with lightning powers. The Avatar of Xolotal appears just outside of Xibala, within the Den of Xolotal, surrounded by Sons of Xolotal. It appears the Kao-Tien were attempting to subjugate the powers of the creature before being slain by its guardians.

Xylem's Tower (or Azshara Tower) is a mage tower located at Bear's Head in Azshara. The only way to get to it is to receive a teleport from Sanath Lim-yo. It is the home of Archmage Xylem, Coral Moongale and a few others.

Yinny is a human rogue and a member of the Alliance. She wields a dagger and shortbow and wears leather armor. She has combat expertise and weapon finesse. She knows backstab, evasion, finishing strike, improved feint, and tumble. She was once hired by Molus Blackburn (who had been in disguise) to break into the lair of the necromancer Toren Snapjoint and destroy him. She was hired along with fellow Alliance members, including Widge Whistlevalve, Botrek Pahno, Cerise Moonrain, Jarlath Brewbelly, and Maith'hal. After battling Toren, his acolytes and his undead servants in the necromancer's cave, Molus entered the cave no longer disguised, and with some hired muscle. He attacked the weakened h
Yanyra Moonfell is a night elf found at the Shrine of Seven Stars. She sells Vanishing Powder. She also appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight where she can be rescued.
Yugh Nakai is a human located at Stormwind City Cemetery in Stormwind City.
Yoska Merce is a human located at Stormwind City Cemetery in Stormwind City.
Zaralda is a blood elf leatherworking vendor located on the Walk of Elders in the capital of Silvermoon City.
Zathanna is a blood elf wand vendor located in Velaani's Arcane Goods in the Walk of Elders in Silvermoon City.

Zazo is an orc located in The Broken Tusk in the Valley of Strength of Orgrimmar. During the Siege of Orgrimmar, he and some other inhabitants of the city are held captive by the Kor'kron. He had to follow Mojka into battle but apparently survived as he is still in Orgrimmar.

Zelifrax Wobblepox was a powerful gnome warlock member of the Council of the Black Harvest. After convening with his fellow warlocks on the Council, Zelifrax was partnered with Shinfel Blightsworn to hunt down the scattered remnants of the Twilight Cult, and glean what knowledge (and, consequently, power) they could from the cultists -- one way or another.

Zifban was a great wizard whose tower was located in the western side of Silithus. Zifban was working on a number of alchemical formulae before the Twilight's Hammer destroyed his home and killed him. His apprentice Crandor escaped and has been trying to make enough money to buy passage to the eastern continents.

Zinnin Smythe is a powerful worgen warlock member of the Council of the Black Harvest. He was present at the Maelstrom and was made mute from the trauma of watching Deathwing being unmade. After convening with his fellow warlocks on the Council, Zinnin was partnered with Ritssyn to venture into Sulfuron Keep and gather the power left behind by the Firelord.
Zula Slagfury is a Mag'har orc blacksmithing trainer located in the Lower City in Shattrath City.
AQ Small Set is a human located in the Trade District in Stormwind City and in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. He provides the Cenarion Circle sets for free.
Acolyte Aselyn is a blood elf located in the Sanctum of Light in Silvermoon City.
Aeliath is a blood elf located in the Sanctum of Light in Silvermoon City.
Aeriekeeper Heliothe is a blood elf located at Sunwing Rookery in Silvermoon City.
Alendis is a blood elf located in Murder Row in Silvermoon City.
Alina Everlark is a blood elf located in the Thalassian University in Silvermoon City.
Anuve Liltleaf is a blood elf located in Delver's Headquarters in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City. He is an expert in Gorian Empire.
Archmage Oodie is a blood elf located outside of Sunfury Spire in Silvermoon City.

Archmage Velor Cloudlight is a high elf. At first, he could be found in Silverglade Refuge in Eversong Woods before he traveled with Vereesa Windrunner to Silvermoon City and then to the Sunwell to help defend it.
Assistant Shadala is a blood elf located by the Trading Post manequins in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City.

Atiesh Vendor is a human located in the Trade District in Stormwind City and in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. He sells the various versions of Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian and provides the related quest items for free.
BWL is a human located in the Trade District in Stormwind City and in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. He sells loot from and . He provides relevant gear tokens for free.
Beliam is a blood elf located in the Sanctum of Light in Silvermoon City.
Belli is a blood elf located in the Murder Row in Silvermoon City while the Trial of Style world event is active.
Bloomkeeper Thornflare is a blood elf located in the Thalassian University in Silvermoon City and in Collegiate Calamity.

Calcia was one of Neltharion's most trusted scale-crafters and the leader of the black dragonflight's scalesmiths. She and her scalesmiths worked with the blue dragonflight to stabilize the earth beneath the Broodlands during Iridikron's onslaught of seismic activity by placing enchanted obelisks beneath the earth to dampen the quakes. Neltharion assigned her to develop obelisks that would sense the oncoming vibrations and emit a counteracting force of equal intensity. While working on the construction of a statue on the outskirts of Valdrakken she and one of the titan-forged discussed the death of Tyr, unaware that Zakarnos was watching them. Captain Preyholder is a human located in Astalor's Sanctum in Silvermoon City.
Captain Flaresworn is a blood elf located in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City.
Cataloger Crimsonmane is a blood elf located in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City.
Cataloger Lendeya is a blood elf located in a building at the Gardens of Remembrance in Silvermoon City.
Celoenus Blackflame is a blood elf located in the Thalassian University in Silvermoon City and in Collegiate Calamity.
Corlen Hordralin is a blood elf who visits Founder's Point and Razorwind Shores. He also appears in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City.

Crusader Sombersun was a blood elf paladin who served in the Blood Knights during the defense of Quel'Thalas as part of the War of Light and Shadow. As part of a group of paladins led by Crusader Dawnheart, Sombersun departed Silvermoon to investigate alleged Twilight's Blade activity in the Sanctum of the Moon, west of Tranquillien. Shortly thereafter, the group was noted by their compatriots Taelia Fordragon and Salandria as having dropped out of contact. Enlisting the help of adventurers, the two traveled to the Sanctum, where Sombersun's body was located, mangled by the shadelings that the cultists had summoned. The adventurer later made Salandria of Sombersun's death.

Cysanz was an ancient proto-dragon and one of Vyranoth's supporters during the War of the Scaleborn. He had been reluctant to join the Primalist cause, but as with many of the ancient proto-dragon holdouts he was swayed when word reached him that there was proof of the dragonflights stealing primal dragon eggs. During the War of the Scaleborn he fought at the Reach and at Algeth'ar Academy. When Vyranoth traveled to the Icebound Eye to duel with Alexstrasza she was accompanied by Cysanz and his Frostscales as her guard against any treachery the flights might enact; after Vyranoth's loss of the duel and subsequent imprisonment, Cysanz approached Alexstrasza to announce his defection from the
DMF P6 is a human located in the Trade District in Stormwind City and in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. He sells cards and trinkets from the .
Dalon Sunsugar is a blood elf pastry vendor located in a shop in the Walk of Elders in Silvermoon City.
Auctioneer Darise is a blood elf auctioneer located at the Bazaar in Silvermoon City. By the time of Xal'atath's attack on the Sunwell, Darise became a bookmaker and accepts bets in Murder Row.
Dathri Skyblaze is a blood elf located next to the Rostrum of Transformation in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City.
Denorin is a blood elf located in Denorin's Emporium in Silvermoon City.
Dennia Silvertongue is a blood elf located in Silvery Serenades in Murder Row in Silvermoon City.
Dethelin is a blood elf located in Murder Row in Silvermoon City.

Distyia was a black dragon who the red dragon Veritistrasz loved and called a friend. After the black dragonflight succumbed to the corruption of the Old Gods, Veritistrasz recalled to adventurers listening to his story the horror he felt when he returned home to find her standing over the bodies of his family, the gut-wrenching despair as he plunged his claws into her throat, and the hate in her eyes as the light went out in them. Though he couldn't remember her name at first, the adventurers that listened to his story later found a Partially Destroyed Diary of a young black dragon that had his name written on the back of it within the Obsidian Citadel. After bringing it to the red dragon,
Dlanor is a blood elf located at the entrance of Students of Shadow in Silvermoon City.
Eager Squire is a blood elf standing next to Knight-Errant Ashlainne in the Hall of Blood in Silvermoon City.
Empowered Shapeshifting is a Druid of the Claw hero talent for druids. It is an exclusive choice node with Wildpower Surge.
Emmery Fiske is a human located in the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind City. After being asked to aid with Zinnia Brooks's duck problem, he teleports to Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.
Faeldin is a blood elf located in Silver Chalice in Silvermoon City.
Farstrider Weaponsmaster is a blood elf located in Silvermoon City.
Fieldweaver Amolenne is a blood elf associated with Decor Duels found in Falconwing Square in Silvermoon City.

Fosura Clearsun is a blood elf vendor located at the Thalassian University in Silvermoon City after completing the Midnight leveling campaign. She sells alcoholic beverages, as well as a few mage-only items.
Frank Ward was a dwarf who was found at Saldean's Farm in Westfall during the original beta. He taught the following hunter pet abilities: *Eye Peck *Flight of the Peregrine *Pester
Gamesmaster Fleurian is a blood elf vendor associated with Decor Duels found in Falconwing Square in Silvermoon City.

Grendag Brightbeard is a dwarf located in the Forlorn Cavern in Ironforge, the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar, and Steamwheedle Port in . He allows players to choose a second talent specialization for , or toggle the ability to gain XP for .
Guard Captain Goldblade is a blood elf located at the entrance to the Royal Exchange in Silvermoon City.
Hakra Split-tooth is an orc located in Delver's Headquarters in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City. She is an expert on the vrykul.
Hawkrancher Saman is a blood elf located in Little Treasures in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City. He teaches how to summon a Golden Dragonhawk Hatchling.

Hesta Forlath is a blood elf housing decor vendor located at the Bazaar in Silvermoon City. She is the apprentice of master painter Corlen Hordralin. She can also be found in any neighborhood where Artistic Aid is the active endeavor. She appears in the Town Center in Founder's Point or the Common in Razorwind Shores.

Igyniar was an ancient proto-dragon who lived with his pack somewhere west of Harrowsdeep. They had long remained neutral during the growing tensions between the Primalists and the dragonflights, but eventually joined the Primalist cause after news reached them of the dragonflights stealing primal dragon eggs. He became one of the greatest champions of the Primalist armies, but perished when he attempted to ascend as an Incarnate of Flame under Iridikron's guidance to replace the imprisoned Fyrakk.
Instructor Thalendir is a blood elf located in Falconwing Square in Silvermoon City.
Intrepid Entrepreneur is a blood elf child located near Wayfarer's Rest in Silvermoon City. Next to them is a dog named Bambi. On the table, the sign says LeMonAde.
Irianora is a blood elf who patrols the Murder Row and the Silver Chalice in Silvermoon City.

Jennara Sunglow is a blood elf enchanting trainer located in the Thalassian University in Silvermoon City. She is on the top floor of the northeast-tower. She teaches all the Gleeful Glamours from for each, except for Gleeful Glamour - Haranir. The gleeful glamours she teaches include:
Jheff is an orc located in Students of Shadow in Silvermoon City.
Jetant Lightstep is a blood elf located in Falconwing Square in Silvermoon City. He is surrounded by spectators as he spars with Rothas the Steadfast.
Jonathar Moonshore is a human paladin patrolling around Stormwind City.
Jonas Everdawn is a blood elf located in Silvermoon City and Eversong Woods.
Kaldis Wildshard is a blood elf located in Thalassian University in Silvermoon City.
Kirin Tor Portal Mages was a high elf located next to a Dalaran portal in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar and a human in the Trade District in Stormwind City during the Radiant Echoes event.
Kiria Brightpalm is a blood elf seen speaking with Tarenar Sunstrike near Wayfarer's Rest in Silvermoon City. <!--
Knight-Errant Ashlainne is a blood elf paladin located in the Hall of Blood in Silvermoon City. Next to her is an Eager Squire.
Knight-Captain Amren Sunsworn is a blood elf located in the Hall of Blood in Silvermoon City.
Knight-Lord Sunguard is a blood elf located in Silvermoon City in Eversong Woods.

Lady Darkglen is a void elf located on Telogrus Rift. When the Shadowguard attacked the Rift, she was seen in Cosmic Horizon summoning portals that shot at their enemies while Blocciniux defended her. Darkglen and Blocciniux accompanied Alleria Windrunner and her fellow void elves to K'aresh to aid in the battle against Dimensius. Additionally, she took on Trader Ba'no as a retainer. They can be found outside of Manaforge Omega. She then traveled to Silvermoon City where she could be seen speaking with Examiner Andoren Dawnrise in the Bazaar. She also appeared in the Voidspire.
Lady Jaxiera is a blood elf located in the Sanctum of Light in Silvermoon City.
Lady Gianna is a blood elf located in the Promenade in the Royal Exchange in Silvermoon City.
Lanrec Dawnblessed is a blood elf located in the Court of Blood in Silvermoon City. He is observing the sparring Blood Knight Adepts.
Loot Vendor is a human located in the Trade District in Stormwind City and in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. He sells gear from Karazhan Crypts.
Lord Delevant is a blood elf located in the Sanctum of Light in Silvermoon City. He can be seen conversing with Terelia.
Lyrendal is a blood elf located in the Crafter's Enclave in Dornogal. After Xal'atath's attack on the Sunwell, he is found in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City.
Lysolde is a blood elf child located on a rooftop in the Walk of Elders in Silvermoon City. She is chasing a group of Harried Wyrmettes.
Madeline Cowle is a blood elf child chasing Carrot near Gott Cowle in the Royal Exchange in Silvermoon City.
Maesh Emberdead is a blood elf located at the Thalassian University in Silvermoon City.
Magistrix Bloodflame is a blood elf located in the Thalassian University in Silvermoon City and in Saltheril's Haven in Eversong Woods.
Maren Silverwing is a blood elf located in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City. She offers equipment rewards in exchange for , which are obtained through Ritual Sites and Void Assaults.
Matron Selinore is a blood elf located in the Sanctum of Light in Silvermoon City.
Mayven Ombrewing is a void elf located in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City. She is busy studying Dark Particles.
Messenger Aelor is a void elf located in Silvermoon City. Magister Umbric tasked him with wrangling an able-bodied champion to assist him with his apprentice Leona Darkstrider.
Mirdril Freeflame is a blood elf located in Thalassian University in Silvermoon City.
Miss Len'dali is a blood elf located in Murder Row in Silvermoon City.
Myinia is a blood elf located in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City.
Nael Silvertongue is a blood elf located in Silvery Serenades in Murder Row in Silvermoon City.

Nalyss was a high elf ranger of the Farstriders before the Second War. At one point, she was training Lyana at Farstriders' Square in Silvermoon City and Sylvanas Windrunner brought Ranger Nathanos Marris to the area. Nalyss bowed to her, and Sylvanas asked her to give them space for practice, which Nalyss obliged. Her status after the wars is unknown.
Naxxramas Gear is a human located in the Trade District in Stormwind City and in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. He sells loot from . Armor pieces have the Sanctified tag.
Nyssira is a blood elf located in the Sanctum of Light in Silvermoon City.

Om'bera was a member of The Ravel and wielder of one of the Reshii Ribbons. After the destruction of K'aresh, she became a broker. She and Om'resh worked as a team for a thousand years. As a member of Cartel Om, she was the owner and administrator of Eco-Dome: Rhovan. There, Om'bera worked alongside Om'resh with a number of dome caretakers until the dome was destroyed by a Void meteor. When the meteor destroyed the dome, Om'resh and Om'bera became separated as scavengers of the Great Dark Beyond set upon them. Om'bera was murdered with a Tabiqa Dagger by a Wastelander affiliate of Soul-Scribe. She managed to struggle enough against her attacker(s) as there was evidence of ethereal wrappings
Orin Straylight is a void elf located in Silvermoon City and Slayer's Rise.
Outfitter Meladine is a blood elf located at Sunwing Rookery in Silvermoon City.
P6 Undermine Coin is a human located in the Trade District in Stormwind City and in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. He sells a number of relics.
Propagandist Naicira is a blood elf associated with Decor Duels found in Falconwing Square in Silvermoon City.
Ranger-Captain Dawnfletch is a blood elf located in Silvermoon City.
Relorin Lighthand is a blood elf located in the Fissure in Dornogal. He can be found talking with Hargrin. He also appears in the Murder Row at Silvermoon City.
Rendron is a blood elf located in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City.
Riftblade Astre is a void elf located in Silvermoon City and the Voidstorm.
Richmond is a blood elf located at the Thalassian University in Silvermoon City.
Rosalyn Brightdawn is a blood elf located at the trading post in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City.
Sandee Seabraid is a dwarf located in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City.

Sarvi was a blood elf street rat located in the Murder Row in Silvermoon City. Magister Aradis hired her to find an adventurer to do a job for him. Aradis was an unscrupulous warlock who regularly kidnapped Murder Row residents and locked them up in his basement, draining them for his experiments. He later kidnapped Sarvi as well, and by the time Jaeth and the adventurer broke into Aradis's basement, Sarvi was already dead.
Sedona Duskspire is a blood elf located in Silvermoon City. She appears to be .
Selinde is a blood elf located in the Den of Indulgence in Murder Row in Silvermoon City.
Sergeant Vornin is a blood elf located in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City.

Solannia is a blood elf located in Falconwing Square in Silvermoon City. She walks around some Farstrider Trainees and a group of spectators watching the fight between Jetant Lightstep and Rothas the Steadfast, occasionally stopping to watch herself.

Speaker Nalridun is a man'ari eredar located in the Grove of Naroua in Krokuun. Nalridun started a cult and recruited a small army of cultists who believed he spoke for Sargeras through the :Brilliant Star he had obtained when Kil'jaeden died. Arzal'kal, having learned of this and failed to reason with him, asked the Argussian Reach, and then Prophet Velen and the adventurers from Azeroth for help kill Nalridum. Once the Speaker was killed, the Brilliant Star was recovered and given to Velen.
Spring Sorter is a human or blood elf located in Valdrakken, Dornogal, and Silvermoon City.
Steph Krep'sea is a blood elf located in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City.

T2.5 is a human located in the Trade District in Stormwind City and in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. He sells pieces of the Brood of Nozdormu sets, and provides the various related boss drop ingredients for free.
T2 is a human located in the Trade District in Stormwind City and in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. He sells tier 2 pieces with the Draconic tag.
T2 Alt is a human located in the Trade District in Stormwind City and in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. He sells tier 2 pieces with tier 1 set bonuses and the tag.
T3 is a human located in the Trade District in Stormwind City and in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. He sells tier 3 pieces with the Sanctified tag.
Terelia is a blood elf located in the Sanctum of Light in Silvermoon City. She can be seen conversing with Lord Delevant.
Triam Dawnsetter is a void elf located in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City.

Umbrenion was a member of the black dragonflight and one of Neltharion's most trusted scale-crafters, as well as the principle architect of the Obsidian Citadel. When a massive piece of infused [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fulgurite fulgurite] was discovered in the ruins of a mortal village that had been destroyed by a draconic attack, Neltharion had it sent to Umbrenion to discern if Raszageth was responsible for its creation.
Undermine Coin is a human located in the Trade District in Stormwind City and in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. He provides a number of relics for free.

Vakthros is an abandoned dragon settlement near Vakthros Summit, atop the Vakthros Range in the eastern Azure Span. It consists of one large and several small towers, built by the blue dragonflight to focus arcane power. Malygos described it as his finest work to date, but also the most delicate, as it is linked to every major ley line in the Azure Span and could cause catastrophic damage if destabilized.
Valeriel is a blood elf vendor located in Murder Row in Silvermoon City.
Velothir is a blood elf vendor located in the Bazaar in Silvermoon City.
Wandering Sellblade is a blood elf located in Falconwing Square in Silvermoon City.
Wildpower Surge is a Druid of the Claw druid hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Empowered Shapeshifting.

Zaethanus was a member of the green dragonflight who defected to the Primalist cause and attempted to destroy the Dream Portal in the Ancient Bough, an act for which Zaethanus was imprisoned in the dungeons of the Obsidian Citadel, around the corner from Talinstrasz.

ZG is a human located in the Trade District in Stormwind City and in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. He sells a large amount of items from . Items normally received from quests are provided for free.

Zerenian was a member of the black dragonflight's Ironscales who fought in the defense of Valdrakken during the Primalist push on the city. As the highest-ranking Ironscale on the field, Zerenian was put in charge of commanding their forces when Neltharion departed to battle with Iridikron.
Zerella is a blood elf located in Falconwing Square in Silvermoon City.

Goetia (Japanese: , Gētia; English dub: ) is an antagonist in and a Ganglion executive. She is of the race of the Ganglion, the founders of the coalition. She first meets the party after the Prone destroy a Lifehold Archive. She is fought by the party but is defeated and saved by an ally. She is later encountered in Oblivia, where she destroys another Lifehold while Irina is trying to open it. During this encounter, she pilots her own mech, Almandal. She is killed in the explosion following Almandal's defeat.

Jin (Japanese: , Shin) is an antagonist in . He is the head of the secret organization Torna who wants to find and capture Pyra, seconded by Malos. Originally known as the Paragon of Torna, Jin's powers revolve around the use of ice and lightning-fast movement. After becoming a Flesh Eater, his powers are greatly enhanced, being able to control elementary particles, albeit suffering from severe pain from time to time. Jin was designed by Tetsuya Nomura, a lead character designer for the Final Fantasy and Kingdom Hearts series.

Rex (Japanese: , Rekkusu; English dub: ) is the main playable character and the male protagonist of . He is a Driver who harnesses the power of a Blade named Pyra, also known as the legendary Aegis. Rex devotes himself into protecting her, and together with Pyra, he goes on a quest to find her long-lost home, Elysium. Due to the Aegis' duality, Rex can use the power of the other incarnation of the weapon, Mythra. Rex was designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer for the game.

Shulk (Japanese: , Shuruku; English dub: ) is the main playable character and the protagonist of . His ability to wield the Monado, using the sword's unique powers, as well as visions of the future, makes him one of the main forces against the Mechon. He is often referred to by some characters as the "Heir to the Monado".

Strength Up (Japanese: , Kinryoku Appu) is a Gem in that increases the character's Strength. This in turn increases the damage dealt by physical attacks, including auto-attacks and physical arts. __TOC__
Drillmaster Zurok is a fel orc found in the Hellfire Peninsula. He is responsible for giving orders to the surrounding Shattered Hand orcs in the area.
Druben Stoutarm is a dwarf located at the Forge in Stormwind City.

Duncan Cullen is a human light armor merchant located in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind City. He is the owner of the shop Duncan's Textiles. The entrance to the shop can be found on the far eastern side of the Mage Quarter, near the entrance from the Trade District.

Drusilla La Salle is a human warlock and warlock trainer located in Northshire Valley outside Northshire Abbey, in Elwynn Forest. She wanted to gain access to a book called Powers of the Void that was held in the Library Wing of Northshire Abbey, but it was in a protected section that would have made her loitering around, being a warlock, very suspicious. When a novice studying at the Abbey joined the Defias Brotherhood and stole the book, Drusilla saw an opportunity to send some of her student warlocks to steal the book back so she could finally obtain it. She is also notable for training novices the ways of the warlock. She can be found in the abbey graveyard, just to the south-east of the
Duinn Steelbrew is a dwarf found in the Shrine of Seven Stars. He is watching Collin Gilbert and laughing very hard. When the sha was brought to the Shrine, he was fighting Collin.

Durak Flamespeaker was an orc found at the small pond in Rocktusk Farm just north of the zeppelin tower in western Durotar. Weakened from the attacks by the Twilight's Hammer, he can been seen kneeling trying to recover his strength. Several dead bodies of Twilight members and Horde guards can be found nearby.

Dungeon Preparation is an aura applied to a party member when they first join a group inside a dungeon. It allows the player to change their talents for free for one minute. With the talent system revamp in Dragonflight, this buff is now redundant.

Duthorian Rall is a human paladin known to be one of the most influential paladins of the Alliance. He is a paladin and a knight of the Silver Hand known to train aspiring paladins in the ways of the Light, often through quests of charity and penance. He is located in the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City, and during the third invasion of the Burning Legion, in the Sanctum of Light.
Earth-Wrought Siegebreaker is a terracotta warrior located in Island Expeditions.
Earthmender Torlock is an orc located at the Altar of Damnation in Shadowmoon Valley.
Earthmender Wilda is an orc located in Coilskar Cistern in the contested territory of Shadowmoon Valley. After you have killed the Keeper of the Cistern, she will wish to be escorted out.

Earthmender Govrum is a Wildhammer dwarf shaman of the Earthen Ring located in the Temple of Earth in Deepholm. He is seen channeling magic into the World Pillar. He appears in the Waking Shores and asks the adventurers to free trapped earth elementals.

Earthmender Narvra is an orc shaman of the Earthen Ring located in the Temple of Earth in Deepholm. She is seen channeling magic into the World Pillar. She joined the Dragonscale Expedition and traveled to the Dragon Isles. She can be found with Rupert, the Gentleman Elemental at the Dragonscale Basecamp in the Waking Shores.
Edna Mullby is a human trade goods vendor located in the Trade District in Stormwind City. She can be found inside her shop Everyday Merchandise, on the corner of the central square.

Eclipse Point is a blood elf controlled draenei ruin in southern Shadowmoon Valley. The population is composed of Eclipsion blood elves, a faction loyal to Illidan Stormrage, and are hostile to everyone. The ruins are filled with a deep blood-red haze, in sharp contrast to the black and fel green colors elsewhere in the valley. Grand Commander Ruusk watches over this bastion.
